description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'GatewayJwtIssuerNotSupportedException' used within a larger project to indicate that a JWT issuer is not supported. It includes builder patterns and static factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and references multiple external classes and interfaces related to exceptions, HTTP status, headers, and JSON parsing.
